title: Create Your Own Work Stack: Deploying Self-hosted AI and Tooling in a Tech Startup
title_zh: 构建你自己的工作栈：在科技初创公司中部署自托管 AI 与工具链

paragraphs.en: Self-hosting AI is often presented as a way to reduce inference costs and increase control, but deployment introduces its own costs. We report our experience deploying a hybrid AI stack at Grayhat Developers, a small software company with an AI-intensive development workflow. Our initial motivation was to counter the growing cost of commercial AI usage: Claude/Codex incurred approximately $325 per month, with more than 25.93 billion recorded tokens. We experimented with local open-source models as replacements for commercial coding agents, but after learning that their performance and inference speed were insufficient, we adopted a hybrid approach in which commercial agents remained responsible for complex tasks while local models handled lower-complexity tasks, organizational information retrieval, and synchronization with self-hosted tools including Outline, Plane, and ERPNext.
paragraphs.zh: 自托管 AI 常被宣传为一种降低推理成本、提升控制力的方式，但部署本身也会带来成本。 我们报告了在 Grayhat Developers（一家开发流程高度依赖 AI 的小型软件公司）部署混合 AI 技术栈的经验。 我们最初的动机是应对商业 AI 使用成本不断上涨的问题：Claude/Codex 每月花费约 325 美元，记录的 token 数超过 259.3 亿。 我们尝试用本地开源模型替代商业编程智能体，但在发现其性能和推理速度不足后，我们采用了混合方案：由商业智能体继续负责复杂任务，而本地模型处理复杂度较低的任务、组织信息检索，以及与 Outline、Plane、ERPNext 等自托管工具的同步。

sents.en: Self-hosting AI is often presented as a way to reduce inference costs and increase control, but deployment introduces its own costs.
sents.zh: 自托管 AI 常被宣传为一种降低推理成本、提升控制力的方式，但部署本身也会带来成本。

sents.en: We report our experience deploying a hybrid AI stack at Grayhat Developers, a small software company with an AI-intensive development workflow.
sents.zh: 我们报告了在 Grayhat Developers（一家开发流程高度依赖 AI 的小型软件公司）部署混合 AI 技术栈的经验。

sents.en: Our initial motivation was to counter the growing cost of commercial AI usage: Claude/Codex incurred approximately $325 per month, with more than 25.93 billion recorded tokens.
sents.zh: 我们最初的动机是应对商业 AI 使用成本不断上涨的问题：Claude/Codex 每月花费约 325 美元，记录的 token 数超过 259.3 亿。

sents.en: We experimented with local open-source models as replacements for commercial coding agents, but after learning that their performance and inference speed were insufficient, we adopted a hybrid approach in which commercial agents remained responsible for complex tasks while local models handled lower-complexity tasks, organizational information retrieval, and synchronization with self-hosted tools including Outline, Plane, and ERPNext.
sents.zh: 我们尝试用本地开源模型替代商业编程智能体，但在发现其性能和推理速度不足后，我们采用了混合方案：由商业智能体继续负责复杂任务，而本地模型处理复杂度较低的任务、组织信息检索，以及与 Outline、Plane、ERPNext 等自托管工具的同步。

paragraphs.en: We estimated that approximately 30–40% of our commercial AI workload was associated with context transfer, documentation synchronization, task management, and related operational coordination. By moving this work to local models, we estimate that approximately 90% of this coordination workload could be handled without commercial inference, corresponding to an estimated 27–36% reduction in overall commercial-AI workload or cost-equivalent usage. Our first internal deployment nevertheless failed to achieve adoption because it introduced UX friction. Replacing it with a centrally configured deployment substantially improved feedback and adoption. We conclude that local inference is most useful not as a wholesale replacement for commercial AI, but as part of a hybrid architecture that assigns tasks according to their capability requirements, cost, context demands, and operational sensitivity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们估计，大约30–40%的商业AI工作负载与上下文传递、文档同步、任务管理及相关运营协调相关。 通过将这部分工作转移到本地模型，我们估计约90%的协调工作负载可以在无需商业推理的情况下完成，相当于整体商业AI工作负载或等效成本用量预计降低27–36%。 然而，我们的首次内部部署未能获得采用，因为它引入了用户体验摩擦。 用集中配置的部署替换它后，反馈和采用情况得到显著改善。 我们得出的结论是，本地推理最有价值的用途并非全面替代商业AI，而是作为混合架构的一部分，根据任务的能力需求、成本、上下文需求和运营敏感性来分配任务。

sents.en: We estimated that approximately 30–40% of our commercial AI workload was associated with context transfer, documentation synchronization, task management, and related operational coordination.
sents.zh: 我们估计，大约30–40%的商业AI工作负载与上下文传递、文档同步、任务管理及相关运营协调相关。

sents.en: By moving this work to local models, we estimate that approximately 90% of this coordination workload could be handled without commercial inference, corresponding to an estimated 27–36% reduction in overall commercial-AI workload or cost-equivalent usage.
sents.zh: 通过将这部分工作转移到本地模型，我们估计约90%的协调工作负载可以在无需商业推理的情况下完成，相当于整体商业AI工作负载或等效成本用量预计降低27–36%。

sents.en: Our first internal deployment nevertheless failed to achieve adoption because it introduced UX friction.
sents.zh: 然而，我们的首次内部部署未能获得采用，因为它引入了用户体验摩擦。

sents.en: Replacing it with a centrally configured deployment substantially improved feedback and adoption.
sents.zh: 用集中配置的部署替换它后，反馈和采用情况得到显著改善。

sents.en: We conclude that local inference is most useful not as a wholesale replacement for commercial AI, but as part of a hybrid architecture that assigns tasks according to their capability requirements, cost, context demands, and operational sensitivity.
sents.zh: 我们得出的结论是，本地推理最有价值的用途并非全面替代商业AI，而是作为混合架构的一部分，根据任务的能力需求、成本、上下文需求和运营敏感性来分配任务。

paragraphs.en: {bazaz, talha.amjad, subhani, sohaib.bazaz, abdullah.aamir}@grayhat.studio
paragraphs.zh: {bazaz, talha.amjad, subhani, sohaib.bazaz, abdullah.aamir}@grayhat.studio

paragraphs.en: Often, the biggest believers are the biggest critics.
paragraphs.zh: 通常，最大的信徒往往是最大的批评者。

paragraphs.en: We are heavy users of AI at Grayhat. We’re a team of under 40 people who build software for startups in San Francisco and develop our own products, and AI-assisted development has become part of our normal workflow. We were therefore not looking for a reason to use less AI. We were looking for a way to use it without allowing the cost and operational complexity to grow with every additional task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Grayhat 是 AI 的重度用户。 我们是一个不到 40 人的团队，为旧金山的初创公司构建软件，同时开发自己的产品，AI 辅助开发已经成为我们日常工作流程的一部分。 因此，我们并不是在寻找减少使用 AI 的理由。 我们寻找的是一种使用 AI 的方式，同时不让成本和运维复杂性随着每增加一项任务而不断增长。

sents.en: We are heavy users of AI at Grayhat.
sents.zh: 我们在 Grayhat 是 AI 的重度用户。

sents.en: We’re a team of under 40 people who build software for startups in San Francisco and develop our own products, and AI-assisted development has become part of our normal workflow.
sents.zh: 我们是一个不到 40 人的团队，为旧金山的初创公司构建软件，同时开发自己的产品，AI 辅助开发已经成为我们日常工作流程的一部分。

sents.en: We were therefore not looking for a reason to use less AI.
sents.zh: 因此，我们并不是在寻找减少使用 AI 的理由。

sents.en: We were looking for a way to use it without allowing the cost and operational complexity to grow with every additional task.
sents.zh: 我们寻找的是一种使用 AI 的方式，同时不让成本和运维复杂性随着每增加一项任务而不断增长。

paragraphs.en: Our immediate problem was commercial AI usage. At one point, five Claude Pro seats could be exhausted around the middle of a billing period. For some routine work, the economics became uncomfortable enough that assigning the work to a human developer was cheaper than continuing to consume commercial model capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们当时最直接的问题是商业化的 AI 使用。 曾有一段时间，五个 Claude Pro 席位在计费周期过半时就会被耗尽。 对于一些常规工作，其成本变得让人难以接受，以至于把工作分配给人类开发者反而比继续消耗商业模型容量更便宜。

sents.en: Our immediate problem was commercial AI usage.
sents.zh: 我们当时最直接的问题是商业化的 AI 使用。

sents.en: At one point, five Claude Pro seats could be exhausted around the middle of a billing period.
sents.zh: 曾有一段时间，五个 Claude Pro 席位在计费周期过半时就会被耗尽。

sents.en: For some routine work, the economics became uncomfortable enough that assigning the work to a human developer was cheaper than continuing to consume commercial model capacity.
sents.zh: 对于一些常规工作，其成本变得让人难以接受，以至于把工作分配给人类开发者反而比继续消耗商业模型容量更便宜。

paragraphs.en: What followed was not a clean engineering project. We tried things that did not work, changed direction several times, and discovered that some of our assumptions about AI adoption were wrong — ultimately documenting a deployment pattern and empirical retrospective showing how a small software organization can use local inference as an organizational-context and orchestration layer while retaining commercial models for capability-intensive development tasks. This can be explained as reminiscent to the Kübler-Ross model of grief ( Kübler-Ross 1969 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 接下来发生的事情并不是一个干净的工程项目。 我们尝试了一些行不通的做法，多次改变方向，并发现我们关于 AI 采用的一些假设是错误的——最终我们记录下了一种部署模式和一份经验性回顾，展示了小型软件组织如何将本地推理用作组织上下文与编排层，同时在能力密集型开发任务中保留商业模型。 这可以被解释为让人联想到库布勒-罗丝（Kübler-Ross）哀伤模型（Kübler-Ross 1969）。

sents.en: What followed was not a clean engineering project.
sents.zh: 接下来发生的事情并不是一个干净的工程项目。

sents.en: We tried things that did not work, changed direction several times, and discovered that some of our assumptions about AI adoption were wrong — ultimately documenting a deployment pattern and empirical retrospective showing how a small software organization can use local inference as an organizational-context and orchestration layer while retaining commercial models for capability-intensive development tasks.
sents.zh: 我们尝试了一些行不通的做法，多次改变方向，并发现我们关于 AI 采用的一些假设是错误的——最终我们记录下了一种部署模式和一份经验性回顾，展示了小型软件组织如何将本地推理用作组织上下文与编排层，同时在能力密集型开发任务中保留商业模型。

sents.en: This can be explained as reminiscent to the Kübler-Ross model of grief ( Kübler-Ross 1969 ) .
sents.zh: 这可以被解释为让人联想到库布勒-罗丝（Kübler-Ross）哀伤模型（Kübler-Ross 1969）。

paragraphs.en: In early 2026, we took on a series of ambitious hyper-casual game development projects with delivery cycles ranging from one to two weeks per game. The projects ran in parallel and involved fewer people than we would traditionally have assigned to that amount of work. Human involvement was concentrated primarily around reviewing outputs, QA, and final validation. This created a highly AI-dependent workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 2026年初，我们承接了一系列雄心勃勃的超休闲游戏开发项目，每款游戏的交付周期为一到两周。 这些项目并行推进，投入的人力少于我们传统上分配给同等工作量的人数。 人的参与主要集中在审查产出、质量保证和最终验证上。 这形成了一个高度依赖人工智能的工作流程。

sents.en: In early 2026, we took on a series of ambitious hyper-casual game development projects with delivery cycles ranging from one to two weeks per game.
sents.zh: 2026年初，我们承接了一系列雄心勃勃的超休闲游戏开发项目，每款游戏的交付周期为一到两周。

sents.en: The projects ran in parallel and involved fewer people than we would traditionally have assigned to that amount of work.
sents.zh: 这些项目并行推进，投入的人力少于我们传统上分配给同等工作量的人数。

sents.en: Human involvement was concentrated primarily around reviewing outputs, QA, and final validation.
sents.zh: 人的参与主要集中在审查产出、质量保证和最终验证上。

sents.en: This created a highly AI-dependent workflow.
sents.zh: 这形成了一个高度依赖人工智能的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: We tried to keep much of our project context in code and repositories. This worked reasonably well for developers who already understood the project, but it soon disconnected the rest of the organization from that context, including designers and managers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们试图将大部分项目上下文保存在代码和代码仓库中。 对于已经了解该项目的开发者来说，这种方式效果尚可，但很快就让组织中其他人（包括设计师和经理）与这些上下文脱节了。

sents.en: We tried to keep much of our project context in code and repositories.
sents.zh: 我们试图将大部分项目上下文保存在代码和代码仓库中。

sents.en: This worked reasonably well for developers who already understood the project, but it soon disconnected the rest of the organization from that context, including designers and managers.
sents.zh: 对于已经了解该项目的开发者来说，这种方式效果尚可，但很快就让组织中其他人（包括设计师和经理）与这些上下文脱节了。

paragraphs.en: Our initial hypothesis was that AI would primarily reduce development costs. We instead found friction in collaboration and management, so we connected the AI to MCP servers ( Model Context Protocol 2026 ) for each self-hosted tool: Outline ( Outline 2026 ) for documentation, Plane ( Plane 2026 ) for ticket management, and ERPNext ( Frappe Technologies Pvt. Ltd. 2026 ) for general management and organizational information.
paragraphs.zh: 我们最初的假设是，AI 主要会降低开发成本。 我们却发现摩擦出现在协作与管理方面，因此我们将 AI 接入了 MCP 服务器（Model Context Protocol 2026），对应每个自托管工具：用于文档管理的 Outline（Outline 2026）、用于工单管理的 Plane（Plane 2026），以及用于 通用管理与组织信息的 ERPNext（Frappe Technologies Pvt. Ltd. 2026）。

sents.en: Our initial hypothesis was that AI would primarily reduce development costs.
sents.zh: 我们最初的假设是，AI 主要会降低开发成本。

sents.en: We instead found friction in collaboration and management, so we connected the AI to MCP servers ( Model Context Protocol 2026 ) for each self-hosted tool: Outline ( Outline 2026 ) for documentation, Plane ( Plane 2026 ) for ticket management, and ERPNext ( Frappe Technologies Pvt.
sents.zh: 我们却发现摩擦出现在协作与管理方面，因此我们将 AI 接入了 MCP 服务器（Model Context Protocol 2026），对应每个自托管工具：用于文档管理的 Outline（Outline 2026）、用于工单管理的 Plane（Plane 2026），以及用于

sents.en: Ltd. 2026 ) for general management and organizational information.
sents.zh: 通用管理与组织信息的 ERPNext（Frappe Technologies Pvt. Ltd. 2026）。

paragraphs.en: The resulting AI usage was already substantial. Seven Claude Team/Claude Code seats cost approximately $175 per month, while seven Codex subscriptions added approximately $140; usage-based credits added approximately $10. Across these services, recorded activity exceeded 25.93 billion tokens at a recurring cost of approximately $325 per month (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 由此产生的 AI 使用量已经相当可观。 七个 Claude Team/Claude Code 席位每月费用约为 175 美元，七个 Codex 订阅额外增加约 140 美元；基于用量的额度额外增加约 10 美元。 在这些服务中，记录的活动超过 259.3 亿 tokens，经常性成本约为每月 325 美元（表 1）。

sents.en: The resulting AI usage was already substantial.
sents.zh: 由此产生的 AI 使用量已经相当可观。

sents.en: Seven Claude Team/Claude Code seats cost approximately $175 per month, while seven Codex subscriptions added approximately $140; usage-based credits added approximately $10.
sents.zh: 七个 Claude Team/Claude Code 席位每月费用约为 175 美元，七个 Codex 订阅额外增加约 140 美元；基于用量的额度额外增加约 10 美元。

sents.en: Across these services, recorded activity exceeded 25.93 billion tokens at a recurring cost of approximately $325 per month (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 在这些服务中，记录的活动超过 259.3 亿 tokens，经常性成本约为每月 325 美元（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: Based on repeated workflow observation, approximately 20% of a typical usage window was consumed by documentation synchronization and a further 10–15% by task and project-management synchronization. We therefore estimated that 30–40% of workload involved context transfer, tool descriptions, MCP calls, and operational synchronization rather than coding or higher-value reasoning. This was an operational estimate rather than a controlled token measurement. Prior work similarly identifies substantial context overhead in MCP-based tool use. ( Jayanti and Han 2026 )
paragraphs.zh: 根据对工作流程的反复观察，在典型的使用窗口中，约20%的时间被文档同步消耗，另有10–15%被任务与项目管理同步消耗。 因此我们估计，30–40%的工作量涉及上下文传递、工具描述、MCP 调用与操作性同步，而非编码或更高价值的推理。 这是一个操作性估计，而非受控的 token 测量。 先前的工作同样指出，基于 MCP 的工具使用存在大量上下文开销。（Jayanti and Han 2026）

sents.en: Based on repeated workflow observation, approximately 20% of a typical usage window was consumed by documentation synchronization and a further 10–15% by task and project-management synchronization.
sents.zh: 根据对工作流程的反复观察，在典型的使用窗口中，约20%的时间被文档同步消耗，另有10–15%被任务与项目管理同步消耗。

sents.en: We therefore estimated that 30–40% of workload involved context transfer, tool descriptions, MCP calls, and operational synchronization rather than coding or higher-value reasoning.
sents.zh: 因此我们估计，30–40%的工作量涉及上下文传递、工具描述、MCP 调用与操作性同步，而非编码或更高价值的推理。

sents.en: This was an operational estimate rather than a controlled token measurement.
sents.zh: 这是一个操作性估计，而非受控的 token 测量。

sents.en: Prior work similarly identifies substantial context overhead in MCP-based tool use. ( Jayanti and Han 2026 )
sents.zh: 先前的工作同样指出，基于 MCP 的工具使用存在大量上下文开销。（Jayanti and Han 2026）

paragraphs.en: Our first proposed solution was simple: try to cut out the paid models entirely.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的第一个解决方案很简单：尝试完全砍掉付费模型。

paragraphs.en: We experimented with self-hosted models, including Kimi ( Kimi Team 2025 ) and DeepSeek ( DeepSeek-AI 2024 ) , using various harnesses and open-source IDEs on real development tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们试验了自托管模型，包括 Kimi（ Kimi Team 2025 ）和 DeepSeek（ DeepSeek-AI 2024 ），在真实开发任务中使用各种测试框架和开源 IDE 进行评估。

paragraphs.en: The experience was frustrating for the engineers, who had prior experience with paid cloud models. The models were useful for some tasks, but the gap became obvious when we asked them to perform more complicated coding work. A model could produce reasonable snippets and handle smaller requests while still being unsuitable as a replacement for the coding agents our developers were already using.
paragraphs.zh: 这段经历让工程师们感到沮丧，他们此前已有使用付费云模型的经验。 这些模型对某些任务是有用的，但当我们让它们执行更复杂的编码工作时，差距就显现出来了。 一个模型可以生成合理的代码片段并处理较小的请求，但仍然不适合作为开发人员已经在使用的编码智能体的替代品。

sents.en: The experience was frustrating for the engineers, who had prior experience with paid cloud models.
sents.zh: 这段经历让工程师们感到沮丧，他们此前已有使用付费云模型的经验。

sents.en: The models were useful for some tasks, but the gap became obvious when we asked them to perform more complicated coding work.
sents.zh: 这些模型对某些任务是有用的，但当我们让它们执行更复杂的编码工作时，差距就显现出来了。

sents.en: A model could produce reasonable snippets and handle smaller requests while still being unsuitable as a replacement for the coding agents our developers were already using.
sents.zh: 一个模型可以生成合理的代码片段并处理较小的请求，但仍然不适合作为开发人员已经在使用的编码智能体的替代品。

paragraphs.en: The gap was particularly noticeable for repository-level work requiring large context windows and fast inference. On realistic consumer hardware, the models were either too slow or insufficiently capable of understanding existing code, dependencies, and conventions without affecting unrelated parts of the application. ( Jimenez et al. 2024 ; Zhang et al. 2024 )
paragraphs.zh: 这一差距在需要大上下文窗口和快速推理的仓库级工作中尤为明显。 在现实的消费级硬件上，这些模型要么速度太慢，要么能力不足以在理解现有代码、依赖关系和约定规范的同时不影响应用程序中无关的部分。 (Jimenez et al. 2024; Zhang et al. 2024)

sents.en: The gap was particularly noticeable for repository-level work requiring large context windows and fast inference.
sents.zh: 这一差距在需要大上下文窗口和快速推理的仓库级工作中尤为明显。

sents.en: On realistic consumer hardware, the models were either too slow or insufficiently capable of understanding existing code, dependencies, and conventions without affecting unrelated parts of the application.
sents.zh: 在现实的消费级硬件上，这些模型要么速度太慢，要么能力不足以在理解现有代码、依赖关系和约定规范的同时不影响应用程序中无关的部分。

sents.en: ( Jimenez et al. 2024 ; Zhang et al. 2024 )
sents.zh: (Jimenez et al. 2024; Zhang et al. 2024)

paragraphs.en: Instead of trying to replace our commercial coding agents, we took a more hybrid approach. The concept of a single, universal AI model for everyday grunt work was flawed - many tasks, similar to the ones in nature, do not require 100% of brain power at all times. We therefore decided which tasks could be handled by local models and which required the capabilities of commercial coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们没有尝试取代我们的商业编程智能体，而是采取了更加混合的方式。 用单一、通用的 AI 模型来处理日常繁琐工作的理念是有缺陷的——许多任务，就像自然界中的情况一样，并不需要在所有时刻都动用 100% 的大脑算力。 因此，我们决定哪些任务可以由本地模型处理，哪些任务需要商业编程智能体的能力。

sents.en: Instead of trying to replace our commercial coding agents, we took a more hybrid approach.
sents.zh: 我们没有尝试取代我们的商业编程智能体，而是采取了更加混合的方式。

sents.en: The concept of a single, universal AI model for everyday grunt work was flawed - many tasks, similar to the ones in nature, do not require 100% of brain power at all times.
sents.zh: 用单一、通用的 AI 模型来处理日常繁琐工作的理念是有缺陷的——许多任务，就像自然界中的情况一样，并不需要在所有时刻都动用 100% 的大脑算力。

sents.en: We therefore decided which tasks could be handled by local models and which required the capabilities of commercial coding agents.
sents.zh: 因此，我们决定哪些任务可以由本地模型处理，哪些任务需要商业编程智能体的能力。

paragraphs.en: We had already deployed Outline, Plane, and ERPNext using Coolify ( CoolLabs 2026 ) on a machine running on our premises. We tied together authentication for these tools using Authentik ( Authentik 2026 ) . We then self-hosted the MCP servers that connected our AI systems to internal tools on the same machine. The hardware configuration is provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经使用 Coolify（CoolLabs 2026）在我们本地的一台机器上部署了 Outline、Plane 和 ERPNext。 我们使用 Authentik（Authentik 2026）将这些工具的认证整合在一起。 随后，我们在同一台机器上自行托管了将我们的人工智能系统连接到内部工具的 MCP 服务器。 硬件配置见附录 A。

sents.en: We had already deployed Outline, Plane, and ERPNext using Coolify ( CoolLabs 2026 ) on a machine running on our premises.
sents.zh: 我们已经使用 Coolify（CoolLabs 2026）在我们本地的一台机器上部署了 Outline、Plane 和 ERPNext。

sents.en: We tied together authentication for these tools using Authentik ( Authentik 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们使用 Authentik（Authentik 2026）将这些工具的认证整合在一起。

sents.en: We then self-hosted the MCP servers that connected our AI systems to internal tools on the same machine.
sents.zh: 随后，我们在同一台机器上自行托管了将我们的人工智能系统连接到内部工具的 MCP 服务器。

sents.en: The hardware configuration is provided in Appendix A .
sents.zh: 硬件配置见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: We used a separate machine for AI workloads. Its hardware and software configuration is also provided in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了一台单独的机器来运行 AI 工作负载。 其硬件和软件配置也在附录 A 中提供。

sents.en: We used a separate machine for AI workloads.
sents.zh: 我们使用了一台单独的机器来运行 AI 工作负载。

sents.en: Its hardware and software configuration is also provided in Appendix A .
sents.zh: 其硬件和软件配置也在附录 A 中提供。

paragraphs.en: We started with Gemma 3 2.7B ( Gemma Team 2025 ) , and later shifted to the latest available Gemma model at the time of deployment. The LLM was deployed as llama.cpp instances managed by GPUStack ( GPUStack Authors 2026 ) . The AI chat interface (explained in sections ahead) was connected to the AI inference server through local IP.
paragraphs.zh: 我们最初使用 Gemma 3 2.7B（Gemma Team 2025），后来切换到部署时可用的最新 Gemma 模型。 该大语言模型以 llama.cpp 实例的形式部署，由 GPUStack（GPUStack Authors 2026）进行管理。 AI 聊天界面（将在后文各节中说明）通过本地 IP 连接到 AI 推理服务器。

sents.en: We started with Gemma 3 2.7B ( Gemma Team 2025 ) , and later shifted to the latest available Gemma model at the time of deployment.
sents.zh: 我们最初使用 Gemma 3 2.7B（Gemma Team 2025），后来切换到部署时可用的最新 Gemma 模型。

sents.en: The LLM was deployed as llama.cpp instances managed by GPUStack ( GPUStack Authors 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 该大语言模型以 llama.cpp 实例的形式部署，由 GPUStack（GPUStack Authors 2026）进行管理。

sents.en: The AI chat interface (explained in sections ahead) was connected to the AI inference server through local IP.
sents.zh: AI 聊天界面（将在后文各节中说明）通过本地 IP 连接到 AI 推理服务器。

paragraphs.en: The process, highlighted in Figure 1 , was roughly as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 该流程如图 1 所示，大致如下：

paragraphs.en: Humans use local models to retrieve information from Outline and Plane, summarize it, and transform it into a form that can be used by coding agents, such as files in the repository like AGENTS.md .
paragraphs.zh: 人类使用本地模型从 Outline（大纲）和 Plane（平面）中检索信息、进行总结，并将其转换为可被编码智能体使用的形式，例如仓库中的 AGENTS.md 等文件。

paragraphs.en: Commercial coding agents remain the preferred option for complex coding tasks and repository-level development. Tasks are written to files in the repository for the coding agents to use.
paragraphs.zh: 商业编程智能体仍然是复杂编程任务和仓库级开发的首选选项。 任务会被写入仓库中的文件，供编程智能体使用。

sents.en: Commercial coding agents remain the preferred option for complex coding tasks and repository-level development.
sents.zh: 商业编程智能体仍然是复杂编程任务和仓库级开发的首选选项。

sents.en: Tasks are written to files in the repository for the coding agents to use.
sents.zh: 任务会被写入仓库中的文件，供编程智能体使用。

paragraphs.en: Humans use local models to read the tasks produced by coding agents and translate them into tickets that can be pushed to Plane.
paragraphs.zh: 人类使用本地模型来阅读编码智能体产生的任务，并将其翻译为可以推送到 Plane 的工单（tickets）。

paragraphs.en: Our first internal AI interface, called version 1 , was LobeHub ( LobeHub 2026 ) . We set it up on our own devices, and created a tutorial for other users to follow to connect it to our MCP infrastructure. After QA, we released the system for external testing with the rest of the company.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的首个内部 AI 界面，称为版本 1，是 LobeHub（LobeHub 2026）。 我们在自己的设备上进行了搭建，并创建了一个教程，供其他用户按照步骤将其连接到我们的 MCP 基础设施。 经过质量保证测试后，我们向公司其余人员发布了该系统进行外部测试。

sents.en: Our first internal AI interface, called version 1 , was LobeHub ( LobeHub 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们的首个内部 AI 界面，称为版本 1，是 LobeHub（LobeHub 2026）。

sents.en: We set it up on our own devices, and created a tutorial for other users to follow to connect it to our MCP infrastructure.
sents.zh: 我们在自己的设备上进行了搭建，并创建了一个教程，供其他用户按照步骤将其连接到我们的 MCP 基础设施。

sents.en: After QA, we released the system for external testing with the rest of the company.
sents.zh: 经过质量保证测试后，我们向公司其余人员发布了该系统进行外部测试。

paragraphs.en: However, the team did not adopt it. The first few demos were great, but people did not actually use it regularly. We initially thought the reason was that people were accustomed to the quality of commercial AI products and therefore found our implementation lower quality.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，团队并未采用它。 最初几个演示效果很好，但人们实际上并没有经常使用它。 我们最初以为原因是人们习惯了商业 AI 产品的质量，因此觉得我们的实现质量较低。

sents.en: However, the team did not adopt it.
sents.zh: 然而，团队并未采用它。

sents.en: The first few demos were great, but people did not actually use it regularly.
sents.zh: 最初几个演示效果很好，但人们实际上并没有经常使用它。

sents.en: We initially thought the reason was that people were accustomed to the quality of commercial AI products and therefore found our implementation lower quality.
sents.zh: 我们最初以为原因是人们习惯了商业 AI 产品的质量，因此觉得我们的实现质量较低。

paragraphs.en: It turned out that the biggest hurdle was UX. Despite being a team of engineers, users found it difficult to configure the AI environment reliably. They needed to know which MCP servers were available, how to configure them, and how to authenticate against the systems they wanted to access, especially in a local environment. Commercial AI products had an advantage here because much of this complexity was hidden from the user.
paragraphs.zh: 结果证明，最大的障碍是用户体验（UX）。 尽管是一支工程师团队，用户仍然发现很难可靠地配置 AI 环境。 他们需要知道哪些 MCP 服务器可用、如何配置它们，以及如何对他们想要访问的系统进行身份验证，尤其是在本地环境中。 商业 AI 产品在这方面具有优势，因为许多复杂性都对用户隐藏了。

sents.en: It turned out that the biggest hurdle was UX.
sents.zh: 结果证明，最大的障碍是用户体验（UX）。

sents.en: Despite being a team of engineers, users found it difficult to configure the AI environment reliably.
sents.zh: 尽管是一支工程师团队，用户仍然发现很难可靠地配置 AI 环境。

sents.en: They needed to know which MCP servers were available, how to configure them, and how to authenticate against the systems they wanted to access, especially in a local environment.
sents.zh: 他们需要知道哪些 MCP 服务器可用、如何配置它们，以及如何对他们想要访问的系统进行身份验证，尤其是在本地环境中。

sents.en: Commercial AI products had an advantage here because much of this complexity was hidden from the user.
sents.zh: 商业 AI 产品在这方面具有优势，因为许多复杂性都对用户隐藏了。

paragraphs.en: We replaced LobeHub with a self-hosted LibreChat ( LibreChat 2026 ) deployment, called version 2 . With LibreChat, we moved configuration to a central deployment rather than offloading it to users. Users authenticate new MCPs when first accessing the application. The resulting configuration is shown in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 LobeHub 替换为自行托管的 LibreChat（LibreChat 2026）部署，称为版本 2。 借助 LibreChat，我们将配置迁移到了中央部署中，而不是交给用户自行处理。 用户在首次访问该应用时对新 MCP 进行身份验证。 最终的配置如附录 B 所示。

sents.en: We replaced LobeHub with a self-hosted LibreChat ( LibreChat 2026 ) deployment, called version 2 .
sents.zh: 我们将 LobeHub 替换为自行托管的 LibreChat（LibreChat 2026）部署，称为版本 2。

sents.en: With LibreChat, we moved configuration to a central deployment rather than offloading it to users.
sents.zh: 借助 LibreChat，我们将配置迁移到了中央部署中，而不是交给用户自行处理。

sents.en: Users authenticate new MCPs when first accessing the application.
sents.zh: 用户在首次访问该应用时对新 MCP 进行身份验证。

sents.en: The resulting configuration is shown in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 最终的配置如附录 B 所示。

paragraphs.en: This reduced the number of decisions required before use and improved feedback and adoption from the team.
paragraphs.zh: 这减少了使用前所需的决策数量，并提升了团队的反馈和采用度。

paragraphs.en: The original motivation was reducing commercial AI usage and its associated cost. Our observations suggest that approximately 30–40% of the commercial-AI workload was associated with context synchronization and operational coordination, and approximately 90% of that workload could be handled by local inference. This corresponds to an estimated displacement of 27–36% of overall commercial-AI workload, or approximately $88–117 per month when expressed as a cost-equivalent fraction of the observed $325 monthly commercial-AI spend (Table 4 ). The cost still does not drop dead to zero because of equipment costs, electricity cost, and maintenance costs (USD per hour) by the engineers themselves. We view it as moving some costs from recurring SaaS and model usage into infrastructure and engineering overhead, while gaining more control over the systems and the information flowing through them.
paragraphs.zh: 最初的动机是减少商业 AI 的使用及其相关成本。 我们的观察表明，大约 30–40% 的商业 AI 工作负载与上下文同步和操作协调相关，而其中约 90% 的工作负载可以由本地推理来处理。 这对应于预计可替代整体商业 AI 工作负载的 27–36%，若以成本等值比例表示，则约为每月 88–117 美元，即所观察到的每月 325 美元商业 AI 支出的一部分（表 4）。 成本仍然不会直接降为零，因为还存在设备成本、电力成本以及工程师自身投入的维护成本（每小时美元数）。 我们将其视为把一部分成本从周期性付费的 SaaS 和模型使用转移到基础设施和工程开销上，同时获得对系统以及流经系统的信息的更多控制权。

paragraphs.en: Feedback was categorized into seven issue types: setup and onboarding, AI performance and model quality, reliability and guardrails, tool integrations, UX and trust in output, feature requests, and positive or neutral sentiment. Each distinct reported observation was counted once within its corresponding category. Feedback for v1 is visible in Table 2 , while feedback for v2 is visible in Table 3 . The change in feedback between v1 and v2 is also summarized in Table 3 . Because v1 and v2 feedback were collected using different mechanisms and at different stages of deployment, these counts are descriptive rather than a controlled measure of improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈被归类为七类问题：安装与上手引导、AI 表现与模型质量、可靠性与防护机制、工具集成、用户体验与对输出的信任、功能请求，以及正面或中性情绪。 每个独立的已报告观察在其对应类别中仅计一次。 v1 的反馈见表 2，而 v2 的反馈见表 3。 v1 与 v2 之间的反馈变化也在表 3 中进行了总结。 由于 v1 和 v2 的反馈是通过不同机制、在不同部署阶段收集的，这些计数仅具描述性，而非对改进程度的对照性度量。

paragraphs.en: Networking in our internal network was difficult. Setting up routing for LLM inference to a local machine was harder than expected. Server uptime was also a problem — running the server 24/7 was not needed so we added scheduling, and we added an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) to avoid downtime during power outages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们内部网络中的联网非常困难。 为 LLM 推理设置到本地机器的路由比预期更困难。 服务器正常运行时间也是一个问题——我们并不需要 24/7 全天候运行服务器，因此我们增加了调度功能，并且加装了不间断电源（UPS），以避免停电期间出现停机。

sents.en: Networking in our internal network was difficult.
sents.zh: 我们内部网络中的联网非常困难。

sents.en: Setting up routing for LLM inference to a local machine was harder than expected.
sents.zh: 为 LLM 推理设置到本地机器的路由比预期更困难。

sents.en: Server uptime was also a problem — running the server 24/7 was not needed so we added scheduling, and we added an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) to avoid downtime during power outages.
sents.zh: 服务器正常运行时间也是一个问题——我们并不需要 24/7 全天候运行服务器，因此我们增加了调度功能，并且加装了不间断电源（UPS），以避免停电期间出现停机。

paragraphs.en: We also had to add monitoring tools such as Beszel ( Henry G. D. 2026 ) , as well as analytics within LibreChat itself, to catch errors early. This meant that, in addition to operational features, we had to build observability as well, and that diverted engineering attention from other commercial work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还必须添加诸如 Beszel（Henry G. D. 2026）之类的监控工具，以及 LibreChat 内部的分析功能，以便尽早发现错误。 这意味着，除了运营功能之外，我们还必须构建可观测性，这分散了工程团队对其他商业工作的注意力。

sents.en: We also had to add monitoring tools such as Beszel ( Henry G.
sents.zh: 我们还必须添加诸如 Beszel（Henry G.

sents.en: D. 2026 ) , as well as analytics within LibreChat itself, to catch errors early.
sents.zh: D. 2026）之类的监控工具，以及 LibreChat 内部的分析功能，以便尽早发现错误。

sents.en: This meant that, in addition to operational features, we had to build observability as well, and that diverted engineering attention from other commercial work.
sents.zh: 这意味着，除了运营功能之外，我们还必须构建可观测性，这分散了工程团队对其他商业工作的注意力。

paragraphs.en: Overall, we had to adopt a self-hosting mindset as an entire team. Everyone became responsible for being aware of the servers and for considering what kind of work was being given to each AI model, instead of blindly trusting a commercial model to handle everything. For a small company, this tradeoff needs to be made deliberately.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们整个团队都必须采取一种自托管的思维模式。 每个人都有责任了解服务器的状况，并考虑给每个 AI 模型分配什么样的工作，而不是盲目地信任一个商业模型来处理所有事情。 对于一家小公司来说，这种权衡需要经过深思熟虑后再做出。

sents.en: Overall, we had to adopt a self-hosting mindset as an entire team.
sents.zh: 总体而言，我们整个团队都必须采取一种自托管的思维模式。

sents.en: Everyone became responsible for being aware of the servers and for considering what kind of work was being given to each AI model, instead of blindly trusting a commercial model to handle everything.
sents.zh: 每个人都有责任了解服务器的状况，并考虑给每个 AI 模型分配什么样的工作，而不是盲目地信任一个商业模型来处理所有事情。

sents.en: For a small company, this tradeoff needs to be made deliberately.
sents.zh: 对于一家小公司来说，这种权衡需要经过深思熟虑后再做出。

paragraphs.en: We also learned that local inference is not always the best option. Research into stronger open-source coding models such as GLM-4 ( Zeng et al. 2024 ) continues, but for a small startup, the hardware and setup costs may not be worthwhile for every workload. At the same time, commercial model usage can become expensive when large amounts of context are repeatedly processed. But as mankind and capitalism demand cost-optimization at every stage in tech, higher engineering speed demands that token cost be optimized. So, local inference does not have to replace commercial inference. The two can work in parallel.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还了解到，本地推理并不总是最佳选择。 对 GLM-4（Zeng 等，2024）等更强开源编程模型的研究仍在继续，但对一家小型初创公司而言，并非每类工作负载都值得投入相应的硬件和搭建成本。 与此同时，当大量上下文被反复处理时，使用商业模型的费用可能变得十分高昂。 但随着人类和资本主义要求在技术领域的每个阶段都进行成本优化，更高的工程速度也要求对 token 成本进行优化。 因此，本地推理不必取代商业推理。 两者可以并行运作。

sents.en: We also learned that local inference is not always the best option.
sents.zh: 我们还了解到，本地推理并不总是最佳选择。

sents.en: Research into stronger open-source coding models such as GLM-4 ( Zeng et al. 2024 ) continues, but for a small startup, the hardware and setup costs may not be worthwhile for every workload.
sents.zh: 对 GLM-4（Zeng 等，2024）等更强开源编程模型的研究仍在继续，但对一家小型初创公司而言，并非每类工作负载都值得投入相应的硬件和搭建成本。

sents.en: At the same time, commercial model usage can become expensive when large amounts of context are repeatedly processed.
sents.zh: 与此同时，当大量上下文被反复处理时，使用商业模型的费用可能变得十分高昂。

sents.en: But as mankind and capitalism demand cost-optimization at every stage in tech, higher engineering speed demands that token cost be optimized.
sents.zh: 但随着人类和资本主义要求在技术领域的每个阶段都进行成本优化，更高的工程速度也要求对 token 成本进行优化。

sents.en: So, local inference does not have to replace commercial inference.
sents.zh: 因此，本地推理不必取代商业推理。

sents.en: The two can work in parallel.
sents.zh: 两者可以并行运作。

paragraphs.en: This small example illustrates the distinction: I don’t need my model to know Einstein’s theory of relativity to write a simple Jira ticket. Assigning simpler tasks to smaller local models can therefore reduce cost without requiring the organization to give up stronger commercial models for tasks where they provide a meaningful advantage. ( Chen et al. 2023 ; Ong et al. 2024 )
paragraphs.zh: 这个小例子说明了这种区别：写一个简单的 Jira 工单并不需要我的模型了解爱因斯坦的相对论。 因此，把较简单的任务分配给更小的本地模型可以降低成本，而组织无需放弃更强的商业模型——后者在能带来显著优势的任务上仍然有用。 （Chen 等，2023；Ong 等，2024）

sents.en: This small example illustrates the distinction: I don’t need my model to know Einstein’s theory of relativity to write a simple Jira ticket.
sents.zh: 这个小例子说明了这种区别：写一个简单的 Jira 工单并不需要我的模型了解爱因斯坦的相对论。

sents.en: Assigning simpler tasks to smaller local models can therefore reduce cost without requiring the organization to give up stronger commercial models for tasks where they provide a meaningful advantage.
sents.zh: 因此，把较简单的任务分配给更小的本地模型可以降低成本，而组织无需放弃更强的商业模型——后者在能带来显著优势的任务上仍然有用。

sents.en: ( Chen et al. 2023 ; Ong et al. 2024 )
sents.zh: （Chen 等，2023；Ong 等，2024）

paragraphs.en: Context is part of the cost. The cost of an AI system is not just the cost of generating an answer. If the model needs to retrieve large amounts of information before it can answer, the retrieval and context-construction process becomes part of the workload.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文是成本的一部分。 人工智能系统的成本不仅仅是生成答案的成本。 如果模型在回答之前需要检索大量信息，那么检索与上下文构建过程就成为工作负载的一部分。

sents.en: Context is part of the cost.
sents.zh: 上下文是成本的一部分。

sents.en: The cost of an AI system is not just the cost of generating an answer.
sents.zh: 人工智能系统的成本不仅仅是生成答案的成本。

sents.en: If the model needs to retrieve large amounts of information before it can answer, the retrieval and context-construction process becomes part of the workload.
sents.zh: 如果模型在回答之前需要检索大量信息，那么检索与上下文构建过程就成为工作负载的一部分。

paragraphs.en: AI adoption can fail because of UX even when the AI works. Our LobeHub deployment was a useful example. There was no fundamental technical blocker preventing people from using it. The system simply required too much effort from users before it became useful.
paragraphs.zh: 即使AI本身正常工作，用户体验（UX）问题也可能导致AI采用失败。 我们的LobeHub部署就是一个很好的例子。 并没有什么根本性的技术障碍阻止人们使用它。 只是系统在变得有用之前，需要用户付出太多的努力。

sents.en: AI adoption can fail because of UX even when the AI works.
sents.zh: 即使AI本身正常工作，用户体验（UX）问题也可能导致AI采用失败。

sents.en: Our LobeHub deployment was a useful example.
sents.zh: 我们的LobeHub部署就是一个很好的例子。

sents.en: There was no fundamental technical blocker preventing people from using it.
sents.zh: 并没有什么根本性的技术障碍阻止人们使用它。

sents.en: The system simply required too much effort from users before it became useful.
sents.zh: 只是系统在变得有用之前，需要用户付出太多的努力。

paragraphs.en: The move also reduced our dependence on external AI providers for internal organizational information. Keeping some retrieval and processing local means that not all internal context needs to be sent to an external model provider, hence organizational data can more or less be kept more private than otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 这一举措还降低了我们在内部组织信息方面对外部AI提供商的依赖。 将部分检索和处理保留在本地，意味着并非所有内部上下文都需要发送给外部模型提供商，因此组织数据在某种程度上可以比其他方式更加私密。

sents.en: The move also reduced our dependence on external AI providers for internal organizational information.
sents.zh: 这一举措还降低了我们在内部组织信息方面对外部AI提供商的依赖。

sents.en: Keeping some retrieval and processing local means that not all internal context needs to be sent to an external model provider, hence organizational data can more or less be kept more private than otherwise.
sents.zh: 将部分检索和处理保留在本地，意味着并非所有内部上下文都需要发送给外部模型提供商，因此组织数据在某种程度上可以比其他方式更加私密。

paragraphs.en: Our current setup is still fairly small and manually managed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们目前的设置规模仍然较小，且由人工管理。

paragraphs.en: The division between local and external models is based largely on our experience with different classes of tasks rather than an automated routing system. We would like to make this more systematic, potentially using a lightweight classifier or policy layer, like Jev ( Almeida 2026 ) , to determine which model should handle a request.
paragraphs.zh: 本地模型与外部模型之间的划分主要基于我们在处理不同类别任务时的经验，而非一个自动化的路由系统。 我们希望使这一过程更加系统化，或许可以利用一个轻量级分类器或策略层，例如 Jev（Almeida 2026），来决定由哪个模型来处理某个请求。

sents.en: The division between local and external models is based largely on our experience with different classes of tasks rather than an automated routing system.
sents.zh: 本地模型与外部模型之间的划分主要基于我们在处理不同类别任务时的经验，而非一个自动化的路由系统。

sents.en: We would like to make this more systematic, potentially using a lightweight classifier or policy layer, like Jev ( Almeida 2026 ) , to determine which model should handle a request.
sents.zh: 我们希望使这一过程更加系统化，或许可以利用一个轻量级分类器或策略层，例如 Jev（Almeida 2026），来决定由哪个模型来处理某个请求。

paragraphs.en: We are also interested in separating model responsibilities further. One possible direction is to use a larger local model primarily for reasoning while using a smaller local model for tool selection and execution. This could reduce the amount of expensive inference required for routine tool interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还有兴趣进一步分离模型的职责。 一个可能的方向是使用较大的本地模型主要负责推理，而使用较小的本地模型负责工具选择与执行。 这可以减少常规工具交互所需的昂贵推理量。

sents.en: We are also interested in separating model responsibilities further.
sents.zh: 我们还有兴趣进一步分离模型的职责。

sents.en: One possible direction is to use a larger local model primarily for reasoning while using a smaller local model for tool selection and execution.
sents.zh: 一个可能的方向是使用较大的本地模型主要负责推理，而使用较小的本地模型负责工具选择与执行。

sents.en: This could reduce the amount of expensive inference required for routine tool interactions.
sents.zh: 这可以减少常规工具交互所需的昂贵推理量。

paragraphs.en: Another direction is deeper integration with the coding agents our developers already use. At present, the internal AI system and the coding agents are largely separate systems. We would like them to communicate directly, allowing a coding agent to request organizational context from our local agents without requiring a person to manually move that information between systems. However, autonomous behavior might cause another increase in token usage. A query-manager agent, potentially also running locally or at the edge (on the device where the query was originally made), could sit on top of the system and delegate tasks to the coding agent and internal tool agent.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个方向是与开发者已经在使用的编码智能体进行更深度的集成。 目前，内部 AI 系统与编码智能体在很大程度上是相互独立的系统。 我们希望它们能够直接通信，让编码智能体可以从我们的本地智能体请求组织上下文信息，而无需人工在系统之间手动搬运这些信息。 然而，自主行为可能会导致 token 用量再次上升。 查询管理智能体（可能同样在本地或边缘运行，即在最初发起查询的设备上）可以位于该系统之上，将任务委托给编码智能体和内部工具智能体。

sents.en: Another direction is deeper integration with the coding agents our developers already use.
sents.zh: 另一个方向是与开发者已经在使用的编码智能体进行更深度的集成。

sents.en: At present, the internal AI system and the coding agents are largely separate systems.
sents.zh: 目前，内部 AI 系统与编码智能体在很大程度上是相互独立的系统。

sents.en: We would like them to communicate directly, allowing a coding agent to request organizational context from our local agents without requiring a person to manually move that information between systems.
sents.zh: 我们希望它们能够直接通信，让编码智能体可以从我们的本地智能体请求组织上下文信息，而无需人工在系统之间手动搬运这些信息。

sents.en: However, autonomous behavior might cause another increase in token usage.
sents.zh: 然而，自主行为可能会导致 token 用量再次上升。

sents.en: A query-manager agent, potentially also running locally or at the edge (on the device where the query was originally made), could sit on top of the system and delegate tasks to the coding agent and internal tool agent.
sents.zh: 查询管理智能体（可能同样在本地或边缘运行，即在最初发起查询的设备上）可以位于该系统之上，将任务委托给编码智能体和内部工具智能体。

paragraphs.en: Our cost measurements are operational rather than controlled experiments. We did not establish a formal baseline before beginning the deployment, and several changes happened at approximately the same time. The cost figures therefore describe our experience rather than establishing that self-hosting will produce the same savings for another organization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的成本测量属于运营性质，而非受控实验。 我们在开始部署之前没有建立正式的基线，并且多项变更几乎在同一时间发生。 因此，这些成本数据描述的是我们的经验，而不能证明自托管会为其他组织带来同样的节省。

sents.en: Our cost measurements are operational rather than controlled experiments.
sents.zh: 我们的成本测量属于运营性质，而非受控实验。

sents.en: We did not establish a formal baseline before beginning the deployment, and several changes happened at approximately the same time.
sents.zh: 我们在开始部署之前没有建立正式的基线，并且多项变更几乎在同一时间发生。

sents.en: The cost figures therefore describe our experience rather than establishing that self-hosting will produce the same savings for another organization.
sents.zh: 因此，这些成本数据描述的是我们的经验，而不能证明自托管会为其他组织带来同样的节省。

paragraphs.en: We plan to create a replicable environment, provisionally called “WorkStack,” as a one-click deployment. This would allow us to reproduce the environment more consistently and measure future changes against a clearer baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们计划创建一个可复制的环境，暂定名为「WorkStack」，作为一键部署方案。 这将使我们能够更加一致地复现该环境，并在更清晰的基线上衡量未来的变更。

sents.en: We plan to create a replicable environment, provisionally called “WorkStack,” as a one-click deployment.
sents.zh: 我们计划创建一个可复制的环境，暂定名为「WorkStack」，作为一键部署方案。

sents.en: This would allow us to reproduce the environment more consistently and measure future changes against a clearer baseline.
sents.zh: 这将使我们能够更加一致地复现该环境，并在更清晰的基线上衡量未来的变更。
